question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**wish**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context involves a king being granted a supernatural favour by a god.
 
• The appropriate noun describes a desire or request granted by a divine being.
 
• "**Wish**" (इच्‍छा) aligns with the conventional narrative where gods grant wishes in myths and legends.&l
